chemical_assumptions: Terminal roles are terminal observations only and are not asserted in early states (source/limits). For interface15 the terminal elements are C/C/N with an orientation triplet [15,4,14]; for interface22 the terminal roles are C(aromatic)/C(aromatic)/N(acceptor,aromatic) with orientation triplet [22,6,13]. The interface22 chemical_context explicitly limits that nearest polar pocket atoms do not establish H bonds or energetic contributions, and the conditional_layout_evidence is a fixed-geometry legal-layout count, not atom energies or coordinate intervention effects. The base_band_A 0.35 is an uncalibrated exploratory geometric band, not an interaction energy. No salt-bridge/hydrogen-bond overlap is claimed; no contact-count reward is assumed.
clock_and_representation: Data clock is the fixed domain [0.0,0.5] with current_clock_times [0.0,0.12,0.25,0.5]; teacher_time is 0.5 and the learning window is [0.1,0.5]. The ancestor evidence provides two representations that must not be exchanged: actual current world A and same-forward teacher predicted endpoint world A. The selection_trend note states weights come from score_time and are applied to the proposal at state_time, with proposals beyond the learning window excluded. The parent R19_v2 response is a measured current-program response with no terminal-affinity gradient; its point_rms_A and target_error_mean are the same quantity at first and last, so they are not independent evidence of a spatial reward gradient.
falsifier: The hypothesis is falsified if, under the fixed clock and detached sensing, the interface15 3-point support produces no distinguishable per-slot displacement pattern from the wide 20/25-point support, or if the matched support switches away from [4,14,15] during the window, or if terminal candidates still show n_above_target 0 with no change in the qualified tail. A further falsifier is if the interface22 chemical_context shows the native N placement is not the top-scoring legal layout (native_minus_alternate_mean 0.076, several positive single exchanges), indicating that a nearby region's support is a terminal-only artifact rather than a seed-compatible mode.
formation_retention_value_test: Formation: does the terminal state retain the C/C/N element identity at slots [4,14,15] with the orientation triplet [15,4,14] preserved? Retention: does the matched support remain the same three slots across the window rather than switching to a different assignment (assignment_switch_fraction)? Value: does any terminal candidate reach the target pIC50, given that parent/outcomes shows best_qualified_pic50 8.590, n_above_target 0, and the source/prior_campaign readout states that local identity formation did not equal affinity benefit (R03 N match 95.8% but best qualified pIC50 8.127753).
observable_change: Under the fixed clock and detached sensing, the observable is the per-slot displacement of the three matched slots toward the same-forward teacher predicted endpoint, measured as point_rms_A and target_error_mean over the learning window [0.1,0.5]. The parent R19_v2 response already shows point_rms_A dropping from 0.433 to 0.183 with nonzero updates throughout, so the program does move geometry; the discriminating observable for this hypothesis is whether the 3-point interface15 support produces a different per-slot displacement pattern than the previously tested wide 20/25-point support, not merely a lower global RMS.
relationship_to_failed_families: The source/prior_campaign readout states that the same element-matching cost used on a 3-point N/C region (R16) or a 4-point O region (R18) did not replicate the wider 20/25-point support benefit, and that local identity formation did not equal affinity benefit (R03, R16_v2). The interface22 failure_history shows current is empty and the previous_campaign readout is the same heterogeneous-intervention record, so interface22 has no independent failure label in this campaign. The parent/outcomes shows n_above_target 0 and best_qualified_pic50 8.590, so the failed family is 'formed local identity without reaching the affinity tail', not 'no local identity formed'.
scientific_hypothesis: The interface15 3-point support [4,14,15] (terminal elements C/C/N, orientation triplet [15,4,14]) is a defensible local mode for seeds whose current state already places those three slots near the pocket cluster A:VAL:53:CG1 / A:MET:163:CE / A:HIS:160:CE1 / A:HIS:160:NE2, because the ancestor evidence shows the selected support is present at t=0 and the teacher endpoint target is a distinct, non-identical configuration (slot 14 moves from ~(-31.6,14.1) to ~(-28.3,17.4)). The selection_trend shows the focal path is exactly the selected support (focal coefficients [1,0,0,0] with zero RMSE) while background_mean and native_shift are small and noisy, so the support is a real selected-path feature rather than a terminal-only artifact. This is a local, seed-compatible hypothesis, not a claim of affinity benefit.
support_reason: G000 is selected because its actual regional evidence was queried: the interface15 ancestor evidence returns the selected support [4,14,15] with terminal elements C/C/N and an orientation triplet, and the interface15 selection_trend returns focal coefficients [1,0,0,0] with zero RMSE, showing the support is the selected-path feature rather than a terminal-only artifact. The interface22 chemical_context was also queried and is retained as counterevidence because its native N placement is not the top-scoring legal layout (native_minus_alternate_mean 0.076, several positive single exchanges), so interface22 is not selected as the principal group. The parent R19_v2 response confirms the program already moves geometry (point_rms_A 0.433 to 0.183), so the discriminating question is the per-slot displacement pattern of the 3-point support, not global RMS. Designer must choose the numerical option inside G000 only.
